errors.text: The proposed material system and experiment differ fundamentally from the target: macroscopic sliding of CoCrFeMnNi-type coatings on steel replaces nanoindentation/friction simulation of a 21 Å FeNiCrCoCu coating on single-crystal Cu.
The degradation boundary is placed near 500 K rather than the target onset near 900 K.
The dominant TWIP/tribo-oxide mechanism conflicts with the target mechanism of temperature-induced lattice disorder, dislocation-density evolution, and softening.
The claimed protective tribo-oxide formation and its instability are not directly established by the cited evidence for the proposed system or temperature interval.
